offering_description.value: Olin manufactures chlor-alkali chemicals, vinyl intermediates and epoxy materials for industrial customers. It also manufactures ammunition and clay targets for recreational shooters, law enforcement and military customers, and operates a U.S. Army ammunition plant under contract.

primary_products.value: Chlorine and caustic soda; ethylene dichloride; epoxy resins and intermediates; ammunition; clay shooting targets

primary_services.value: Contract operation of a military ammunition plant

customer_segment.value: B2B: Chemical processors, coatings and composites manufacturers, industrial distributors, sporting goods retailers and shooting ranges; B2G: Military procurement agencies, law enforcement agencies and public water utilities; B2C: Hunters, target shooters and other recreational shooting customers

end_markets.value: Chemical and plastics manufacturing; water treatment; industrial coatings and composites; hunting and shooting sports; defense and law enforcement

revenue_model.value: product sales: Industrial chemicals, epoxy materials, ammunition and clay targets; project or contract: Ammunition production and plant operations for the U.S. Army

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Processes chemical feedstocks and ammunition components into products for industrial buyers, retailers and government agencies; asset operator: Runs company-owned chemical plants that supply industrial customers and operates an ammunition plant for the U.S. Army

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, with U.S. military ammunition operations

specialization.value: diversified: Chlor-alkali chemicals and vinyl intermediates, epoxy materials, and a separate ammunition and clay target business

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Industrial accounts, military procurement agencies and law enforcement agencies; distributors / dealers: Chemical distributors and ammunition wholesalers and dealers; third-party retail: Sporting goods stores and outdoor retailers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Federal ammunition manufacturing licensing through ATF, plus EPA environmental and OSHA process safety rules for chemical plants
